mentions.name: Recipe versioning TUI app
mentions.description: A recipe application centered on iterations and versions of recipes, tracking changes to ingredients and directions to build new recipes from an existing one. It is being built as a Go Bubble Tea TUI.
mentions.source_excerpt: In the mean time, I’m working on a recipe application I’ve had countless false starts on. It’s centered around iterations and version on recipes, tracking changes to ingredients and directions to build new a new recipe from an existing one.
